main_text.l: reditatum , quas λήξεις[?] nuncupare veteres Athenienses solebant , reddebantur capaces, & simul ex ephebis exibant inscripti , suique juris ac arbitrii censebantur, & , si lubebat, conciones obibant , atque adeo communium rerum fiebant participes. Eademque relatio in tabulas has lexiarchicas fores militiae iis aperiebat : Tunc enim ætatem militarem etiam ingrediebantur, obstringebantque se sacramento ad arma pro patria gerenda, cum res poscēret, & auctoritate publica scuto ac hastà instruebantur: durabatque ætas ista militaris in annos xliii, ab anno scilicet vitæ xviii ad annum lx. Atque ideo, ut certius de annis militaribus singulorum constare semper posset, in inscriptione hac nomen archontis eponymi, qui annum signabat, etiam apponebatur. Iurisjurandi, quo se singuli obligabant, hæc fuit sententia : Non dedecoraturos se arma, nec ordinem deserturos, patriamve reddituros deteriorem , sed pro viribus defensuros ; pugnaturosque pro sacris & republica tum solos , tum cum aliis ; navigaturos etiam in terram quamvis sibi assignatam ; legibus jam latis , & deinceps legitimè ferendis obedientiam præstituros: non permissuros, ut quisquam eas tollat; sacra denique patria culturos.

page.notes: Handwriting and stains at the lower left (marks such as "pr.xi" and "bi.4") and a mark at the left edge beside "eas tollat" are not printed text and are left out. Show-through of the next page appears at the left edge near "defensuros" and is left out. The Greek word in the first line is read as λήξεις[?]; the first letters are uncertain. The printed spelling "poscēret" is copied as far as the scan allows, and the macron is not printed. The printed "s" is transcribed as "s" throughout.
